pull_request.title: Software: Integrate nodehammer pixel-barrel display
pull_request.head: software/nodehammer-integration
pull_request.body:
Nodehammer can display the DES-012 pixel-barrel prototype and provides useful selection, cutaways and portable review projects. This PR adds an optional, repeatable integration without changing detector geometry, materials or normal build dependencies.

The workflow source-builds the requested `asalzburger/nodehammer` fork at `30b19dcbd9329b742d98b1383a1484600fc3e0c3` with DD4hep/ROOT importers, using an isolated Conan environment and recipe lock. It generates full-barrel, active-sensor and single-stave `.nhproj` projects and GLBs, with styles from the existing nODD palette. Every entity/transform/sensitive tag is checked against the compact export oracle and again after NHB round trip; selected mesh inventories and GLB metre units/RGBA are checked before reporting success.

Use `python3 tools/nodehammer/build.py`, then `python3 tools/nodehammer/prepare.py` in the documented activated environment. Open the result with `build/nodehammer/native/nodehammer viewer open build/nodehammer/pixel/full.nhproj`. Full setup, paths and screenshot commands: [workflow](tools/nodehammer/README.md). Assessment, retained JSON and actual native screenshots: [results](docs/validation/nodehammer/results.md).

Validation on macOS arm64 / DD4hep 1.38 / ROOT 6.40.04:

- 602/602 upstream tests and 6/6 nODD safeguards pass.
- All 39,386 detector entities match before/after NHB; 6,206 sensitive tags/normals survive. Maximum centre difference 1.14e-13 mm.
- All 36,550 full-view physical placements render, including 492 boolean feet; sensitive/stave views contain 6,206/386 physical placements.
- All exported transforms and box dimensions have checked metre conversion; GLB RGBA/BLEND matches the palette. Native complete/cutaway PNGs rendered and inspected.
- ROOT fallback imports 39,388 nodes with explicit format selection but lacks sensitive tags.
- Dashboard 27/27 Python tests, 14 JavaScript assertions, validation/build and session-log validation pass.

Important limits: native alpha blending is pending upstream; use selection/cuts for buried volumes. Parent/daughter replacement material is not subtracted from display meshes. Internal node indices are not packed DD4hep IDs. Browser runtime/publication and other platforms are unverified. The pinned strict-mode, ROOT-extension and screenshot CLI quirks are documented with verified workarounds; no upstream patches or shared Spack modifications were made. The Spack registry's older setup/lock fingerprints differ, so the relevant runtime capabilities were tested directly.

Tracking: TASK-SOFT-NODEHAMMER, DES-012, ADR-003; adds SRC-NODEHAMMER and a paired session record. No design sign-off is inferred. Exact token counters for this task were unavailable.

Base correction: at the user's request, the existing support/PR30 history was merged and pushed to main at `ed78a3f76583b5061235d458b1cad68db21627d2`, with all 3 DD4hep tests passing. This branch was then rebased onto that main; this PR contains only the nodehammer integration.

events.text:
Recommend nodehammer for optional visual review. Heavy importers are not in its
standard wheel, so a pinned source build enables TGeo/DD4hep and native viewing.
No shared Spack installation was changed. The build helper uses an isolated
Conan environment with the active Spack Python, local profile/cache, retained
recipe lock and binary provenance. Source pin is
30b19dcbd9329b742d98b1383a1484600fc3e0c3; no upstream patch was applied.

The preparation helper checks every named detector entity against expected.json,
then repeats the check through the portable NHB representation. It exports
full, sensitive-only and single-stave projects plus GLBs with verified metre
units and material alpha/BLEND. The full scene keeps physical parents with
children and excludes only world/assembly boxes. Generated styles follow the
existing nODD palette. Source compact and geometry remain unchanged.

All 39386 detector entities match; maximum centre error is 1.14e-13 mm.
All 6206 sensitive tags/normals survive. The full view has 36550 physical mesh
placements, including 492 boolean feet. Native complete/cutaway PNGs were
rendered and inspected. ROOT fallback also imports 39388 nodes but lacks tags.
The report records provenance, inputs, commands and hashes; absolute command
prefixes were normalized to documented checkout placeholders for retention.

Limitations are explicit: native BLEND pending, no parent/daughter material
subtraction, potential coplanar silicon-face artifacts, internal IDs reindexed,
no packed-cell-ID reconstruction claim, browser runtime not qualified. Strict
conversion incorrectly rejects informational diagnostics and ROOT suffix
recognition is defective at the pinned revision. The workflow uses structured
import diagnostics plus placement audits and an explicit TGeo format flag.

events.text: Evaluate and integrate nodehammer display workflow — see the canonical narrative for outcomes and checks.

The user requested: “Make the color setting less stringent, i.e. the root_color
can differ from the rgb setting in the config file”, then “Also make the
transparency requirement relaxed”. They subsequently asked how to start
nodehammer. Supplied the exact existing binary/project command for the terminal
where geoDisplay works, including sensitive/stave alternatives and the native
blending limitation.

Relevant records: DES-012 PB-C13, TASK-SOFT-NODEHAMMER and TASK-SOFT-DD4HEP-PIXEL.
Source provenance SRC-ROOT-TCOLOR/SRC-NODEHAMMER is unchanged. No detector physics
parameter or design approval changes. The requested relaxed display policy is
recorded explicitly in DES-012 and the validation note.
